hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | grep -qE '^git\s+push\s+.*--force' && jq -r '.tool_input.command' | grep -qE '\b(main|master)\b' && echo '{"decision": "deny", "reason": "Force push to main/master is blocked. Use a feature branch."}' || true
jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | grep -qE '^git\s+push\s+.*--force' && echo '{"decision": "ask", "reason": "Force pushing to a feature branch. Are you sure?"}' || true

jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | grep -qE '^git\s+(reset\s+--hard|clean\s+-f)' && echo '{"decision": "ask", "reason": "This is a destructive git operation that may cause data loss. Proceed?"}' || true
